scenarios.title: 在咖啡馆点单
scenarios.scene: 你走进一家咖啡馆，点一杯拿铁。

lines.en: Good morning! What can I get for you?
lines.cn: 早上好！请问您要喝点什么？

lines.en: Hi, I'd like a large latte, please.
lines.cn: 你好，请给我一杯大杯拿铁。

lines.en: Sure. Hot or iced?
Hot, please. And could I have some oat milk?
lines.cn: 热的，谢谢。可以换燕麦奶吗？

lines.en: Of course, that will be thirty-two yuan.
Here you go. Can I get it to go?
No problem. Your latte will be ready in a minute.
lines.cn: 没问题，您的拿铁马上就好。

lines.en: Thanks a lot!

scenarios.tips: 点单常用句：I'd like...（我想要）、Can I get...?（能给我...吗）、to go（带走）。

scenarios.title: 餐厅点餐

lines.en: Are you ready to order?
Yes. We'd like the Mapo Tofu and Kung Pao Chicken.
lines.cn: 是的，我们想要一份麻婆豆腐和宫保鸡丁。

lines.en: Would you like some rice with that?
Two bowls of rice, please. And a bottle of water.
Anything else?
That's all for now, thanks.
Okay, the dishes will be served soon.

scenarios.tips: 点菜可说 We'd like...；结账时说 Could I have the bill, please?

scenarios.title: 问路
scenarios.scene: 在街上向路人询问地铁站的位置。

lines.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the nearest subway station?
lines.cn: 打扰一下，请问最近的地铁站怎么走？

lines.en: Go straight ahead and turn left at the second crossing.
lines.cn: 一直往前走，在第二个路口左转。

lines.en: Is it far from here?
About ten minutes on foot. You won't miss it.
lines.cn: 步行大约十分钟，你不会错过的。

lines.en: Great, thank you so much!
You're welcome. Have a nice day!

scenarios.tips: 问路万能句：Excuse me, how can I get to...?（请问怎么去...?）

scenarios.title: 购物退换
scenarios.scene: 在商场想退掉一件不合身的衣服。

lines.en: Hi, I'd like to return this shirt, please.
lines.cn: 你好，我想退掉这件衬衫。

lines.en: Do you have the receipt?
Yes, here it is. It's a bit too small for me.
lines.cn: 有的，给您。这件对我来说有点小了。

lines.en: No problem. Would you like a refund or an exchange?
lines.cn: 没问题。您要退款还是换一件？

lines.en: I'd like to exchange it for a larger size.
Let me check our stock... We have it in size L.
lines.cn: 我查一下库存……我们有大号的。

lines.en: Perfect, thank you!

scenarios.tips: 退换货关键词：return（退货）、refund（退款）、exchange（换货）、receipt（小票）。

scenarios.title: 机场值机

lines.en: Good morning. May I see your passport, please?
lines.cn: 早上好，请出示您的护照。

lines.en: Here you are. I'd like a window seat if possible.
lines.cn: 给您。如果可以的话我想要靠窗的座位。

lines.en: Sure. Are you checking in any luggage?
lines.cn: 好的。有需要托运的行李吗？

lines.en: Yes, one suitcase.
Please put it on the scale. Your boarding pass and gate number are here.
lines.cn: 请把行李放到秤上。这是您的登机牌和登机口号码。

lines.en: Thank you. What time does boarding start?
lines.cn: 谢谢。什么时候开始登机？

lines.en: Boarding starts at 10:20 at Gate 12.

scenarios.tips: 机场常用：boarding pass（登机牌）、gate（登机口）、window seat（靠窗座位）。

scenarios.title: 面试自我介绍
scenarios.scene: 面试第一轮，向面试官介绍自己。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. Could you introduce yourself briefly?
lines.cn: 很高兴见到你。请简单介绍一下自己。

lines.en: Nice to meet you too. I'm Xu, and I have three years of experience in data analysis.
lines.cn: 我也很高兴见到您。我是Xu，有三年数据分析经验。

lines.en: What attracted you to this position?
lines.cn: 是什么吸引你应聘这个职位？

lines.en: I'm passionate about turning data into decisions, and this role matches my skills.
lines.cn: 我热衷于把数据变成决策，这个职位和我的能力很匹配。

lines.en: What's your greatest strength?
I'm good at solving problems under pressure and I never stop learning.
lines.cn: 我擅长在压力下解决问题，而且从不停止学习。

lines.en: Great. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.cn: 很好。你有什么想问我们的吗？

lines.en: Yes, could you tell me about the team I'd be working with?
lines.cn: 有的，能介绍一下我将合作的团队吗？

scenarios.tips: 面试黄金句式：I have experience in...（我有...经验）、I'm passionate about...（我热爱...）。

scenarios.title: 酒店入住
scenarios.scene: 办理酒店入住，并询问早餐时间。

lines.en: Welcome to our hotel. Do you have a reservation?
lines.cn: 欢迎光临。请问您有预订吗？

lines.en: Yes, under the name Xu.
lines.cn: 有的，用Xu这个名字预订的。

lines.en: Let me check... Yes, a standard room for two nights.
lines.cn: 我查一下……是的，标准间两晚。

lines.en: That's right. What time is breakfast?
Breakfast is served from 7 to 10 a.m. on the second floor.
And what time is check-out?
Check-out is before 12 noon. Here is your room key.
lines.cn: 中午12点前退房。这是您的房卡。

scenarios.tips: 酒店常用：reservation（预订）、check-in（入住）、check-out（退房）、room key（房卡）。

scenarios.title: 看医生

lines.en: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
I have a sore throat and a runny nose.
How long have you felt like this?
Since yesterday. I also have a slight fever.
lines.cn: 从昨天开始的，还有点发烧。

lines.en: Let me take your temperature... It's 37.8. It's a mild cold.
lines.cn: 量一下体温……37.8度，是轻度感冒。

lines.en: Do I need any medicine?
Yes. Take these pills twice a day and drink plenty of water.
lines.cn: 需要。这些药一天两次，多喝水。

scenarios.tips: 看病常用：sore throat（嗓子疼）、runny nose（流鼻涕）、take medicine（吃药）。

scenarios.title: 银行开户
scenarios.scene: 去银行办理一张储蓄卡。

lines.en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
lines.cn: 下午好，请问需要办理什么业务？

lines.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
May I see your ID card, please?
Here it is. What documents do I need?
lines.cn: 给您。还需要什么材料吗？

lines.en: Just your phone number. Please set a six-digit password.
lines.cn: 再留个手机号，并设置六位密码。

lines.en: Done. How long will it take?
About ten minutes. Here's your card.
lines.cn: 大约十分钟。这是您的卡。

scenarios.tips: 银行常用：open an account（开户）、savings account（储蓄账户）、password（密码）。

scenarios.title: 打车去机场
scenarios.scene: 在路边打了一辆出租车去机场。

lines.en: Where are you heading?
The airport, please. I'm in a hurry.
No problem. The traffic is fine at this hour.
lines.cn: 没问题，这个点路况不错。

lines.en: How long will it take?
About twenty-five minutes.
Could you please turn up the air conditioner?
lines.cn: 能麻烦把空调开大一点吗？

lines.en: Sure. We're almost there.

scenarios.tips: 打车常用：I'm in a hurry（我赶时间）、turn up（调大）。

lines.en: Welcome! Are you interested in a membership?
lines.cn: 欢迎光临！想了解会员卡吗？

lines.en: Yes. How much is a monthly pass?
Two hundred yuan per month, or eighteen hundred a year.
What facilities do you have?
We have a full gym, a swimming pool, and yoga classes.
lines.cn: 全套器械、游泳池和瑜伽课。

lines.en: Sounds good. I'll take the yearly plan.

scenarios.title: 打电话订座
scenarios.scene: 给餐厅打电话预订周末的位子。

lines.en: Hello, this is Green Garden Restaurant.
Hi, I'd like to book a table for Saturday night.
lines.cn: 你好，我想订周六晚上的位子。

lines.en: For how many people?
Four people, at seven o'clock.
May I have your name and phone number?
lines.cn: 请留一下您的姓名和电话。

lines.en: All set. We'll keep the table for fifteen minutes.
lines.cn: 订好了，我们会保留位子15分钟。

scenarios.tips: 订座常用：book a table（订位）、keep the table（留位）。

scenarios.title: 超市结账

lines.en: Good evening. Did you find everything?
Yes, thanks. I also have a coupon.
lines.cn: 是的，谢谢。我有一张优惠券。

lines.en: Sure, let me scan it. That will be eighty-six fifty.
Can I pay by mobile?
Of course. Please scan this QR code.
lines.cn: 当然可以，请扫这个二维码。

lines.en: Done. Have a nice evening!

scenarios.tips: 超市常用：coupon（优惠券）、pay by mobile（手机支付）、QR code（二维码）。

scenarios.title: 理发

lines.en: How would you like your hair cut?
Just a trim, and shorter on the sides.
lines.cn: 稍微修一下，两边剪短一点。

lines.en: How about the top?
Keep the top a bit longer, please.
Do you want a wash first?
Yes, please.
All done. How does it look?

scenarios.tips: 理发常用：a trim（修剪）、shorter on the sides（两边剪短）。

scenarios.title: 图书馆借书

lines.en: Excuse me, how do I borrow a book?
lines.cn: 打扰一下，请问怎么借书？

lines.en: You need a library card. Do you have one?
Yes, here it is. I'd like to borrow this novel.
lines.cn: 有，给您。我想借这本小说。

lines.en: It's due in two weeks. You can renew it online.
lines.cn: 两周后到期，可以在网上续借。

lines.en: What if I return it late?
There's a small fine of fifty cents a day.
lines.cn: 每天五毛钱的小额罚款。

lines.en: Got it, thanks!

scenarios.tips: 图书馆常用：borrow（借）、due（到期）、renew（续借）、fine（罚款）。

scenarios.title: 和新邻居打招呼
scenarios.scene: 搬家后第一次见到邻居。

lines.en: Hi, you must be the new neighbor!
Hi! I just moved in yesterday.
Welcome! I'm Li, from next door.
Nice to meet you. I'm Xu.
If you need anything, just knock on my door.
lines.cn: 有什么需要帮忙的，随时敲门。

lines.en: That's so kind. Thanks a lot!

scenarios.tips: 邻居寒暄常用：just moved in（刚搬来）、knock on my door（来敲门找我）。
